name: Sikafloor® Marine-504
tagline: Water-based, 2-component, polyurethane, clear, matt topcoat for internal decks
summary: Sikafloor® Marine-504 is a water-based, 2-component, polyurethane, clear, matt topcoat for internal decks. It is used as a component of the Sikafloor® Marine Deco systems. Sikafloor® Marine-504 has been tested in accordance with the FTP Code system and approved in accordance with IMO Marine Equipment Directives.
metaDescription: Sikafloor® Marine-504 is a water-based, 2-component, polyurethane, clear, matt topcoat for internal decks. It is used as a component of the Sikafloor® Marine Deco systems. Sikafloor® Marine-504 has been tested in accordance with the FTP Code system and approved in accordance with IMO Marine Equipment Directives.
usage: Sikafloor® Marine-504 is designed as a component of the Sikafloor® Marine Deco systems for internal decks in ship and boat construction. This product is suitable for experienced professional users only. Tests with actual substrates and conditions have to be performed to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.

items.label: CURE MECHANISM
items.text: The curing of Sikafloor® Marine-504 takes place by a chemical reaction of the two components. Higher temperatures speed up and lower temperatures slow down the curing process.

items.label: CHEMICAL RESISTANCE
items.text: For advice on chemical resistance contact the Technical Department of Sika Industry.

items.label: Surface preparation
items.text: Dust, loose and friable material must be completely removed from all surfaces before application of the product, preferably by brush or vacuum. Ensure that substrates are clean, dry and free from all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, coatings and other surface treatments.

items.label: Application
items.text:
Prior to application confirm relative air humidity and dew point.
When starting to coat, make sure the coating rollers are well saturated with product.
After proper mixing the product is poured and spread out on the floor in respect of the coat weight. Note: Keep an eye on the pot life since the end of the pot-life is not visible.
Roll with a larger 50 cm roller in one direction cross the working direction to eliminate lap-marks.
Always consult the most current corresponding Application Manual.

items.label: Curing
items.text:
Indications regarding curing details see table below.
Tempera- ture | Foot traffic | Light traffic | Full cure
10 °C | 36 hours | 48 hours | 6 days
20 °C | 16 hours | 24 hours | 4 days
30 °C | 12 hours | 18 hours | 3 days

items.label: Removal
items.text:
Uncured Sikafloor® Marine-504 can be removed from tools and equipment with water. Once cured, the material can only be removed mechanically. Hands and exposed skin have to be washed immediately using hand wipes such as Sika® Cleaner-350H or a suitable industrial hand cleaner and water.
Do not use solvents on skin.

items.label: Application limits
items.text: Freshly applied Sikafloor® Marine-504 must be protected from damp, condensation and water for at least 5 days. Uncured material reacts in contact with water (foaming).
